why: LQ-20261107-154 / DSN-20261107-LLM-AUTOMATION-PROGRAM.md: the LLM proposes, deterministic code disposes. Every AI-written lane listed here is re-audited nightly by scripts/n8n_ai_claim_check.py: null / duplicate / stale / out-of-range / count-disagreement on its own natural key over EVERY record, plus up to three claims per record verified against the STORED source rows (scripts/lib/ai_claim_check.py). Results feed data/quality/ai_claim_check_verdicts.json. A target added here is not scheduled until its allowlist entry and health contract are applied; adding a target spends model calls, so the cap fields are part of the registration.

field_notes.kind: json = one document (records under records_path); jsonl_dir = the newest file matching file_glob in the directory
field_notes.path: relative to the persistent state root, never absolute
field_notes.natural_key: the fields whose tuple must be unique and is quoted as the record's key in every finding
field_notes.required: fields that must not be null/empty; a miss is a null_field finding (FAIL)
field_notes.timestamp_field + max_age_h: staleness is INFO, not FAIL: an old artifact is a lane question, not a data defect
field_notes.ranges: field -> [lo, hi]; a number outside is out_of_range (FAIL)
field_notes.count_matches: declared-int field -> list field it counts; a mismatch is count_disagrees (FAIL)
field_notes.claim_field: the AI-written prose whose sentences are the claims, or null to skip the claim check
field_notes.claim_skip_when: field -> values that make a record claim-free (an honest 'no catalyst' is not a claim)
field_notes.source_text_fields: stored fields the model must quote VERBATIM; a.b, rows[] or rows[].field
field_notes.max_claim_records: hard cap on model calls per target per run; records are spread across the artifact

targets.title: Hermes momentum catalysts (AI-written catalyst_summary)
targets.notes: research_timestamp is stamped in host-local time without an offset; read as UTC it is at most 4-5 h old-er, which the 96 h bound absorbs (and staleness is INFO anyway). Seven of the 25 rows on 2026-11-06 are no_clear_catalyst with confidence 0.2 and no sources: honest absences, skipped by claim_skip_when, never failed for it.

targets.title: CIO prospect shadow build (stage / next action / cognition prose)
targets.notes: Deterministic checks only for now: the prospect rows carry nested prose whose source rows are themselves CIO memory (a retrieval graph), not a quotable source list, so a verbatim-quote claim check here would grade 'no source stored' on every row. The pair key is security_guid+symbol because the artifact's own counts declare duplicate_guid (6 shared guids across two symbols each, 2026-11-06) as a known identity condition; a repeated PAIR is a genuine duplication and is what this target fails on.
